descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S10 「名单大小 0 / 1 / 51：空名单显示四个零，不是破折号或空白页」 Roster size 0 / 1 / 51: an empty roster shows four zeros, not dashes or a blank screen

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently（TFA-92598 How it works 1；TFA-92598 How it works 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given A fresh @roundai.test physician with no patients in either care setting (size 1 is the standard fixture in S05/S07; size 51, across the 50-row page, is S01/S02)

When Open the Hospital dashboard, then the Nursing Home dashboard

Then Both show Total 0, Pending 0, In Progress 0, Complete 0 once loaded. No stuck loading text, no 'being updated' state with '—' tiles, no blank page, no placeholder junk

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Counts match the real list (0 patients → every tile 0). counts 0/0/0/0 on both; mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard'; mustNotContain the standard fixture's patient or resident (proves the roster is really empty), 'Loading rounding status', 'being updated' (the preparing state shows '—' tiles when the list backfill has not run), 'undefined', 'NaN'
